That's a great observation! Many people find that wearing formal or well-fitted clothing can boost confidence and even influence how others perceive them. So if a suit and tie makes you feel more confident, it's likely because you associate that attire with professionalism, authority, or success—and your brain responds accordingly. It's a powerful tool for self-presentation and mindset!
